summary: Uppsala University's Global Scholarship pays the full tuition fee for one international master's programme. It is funded by the Swedish Council for Higher Education and is very competitive: about 2% of applicants receive one.
meta_title: Uppsala Global Scholarship 2027: full tuition for a master's in Sweden
meta_description: Uppsala's Global Scholarship pays full master's tuition. Apply with Uppsala first by 15 January 2027, then for the scholarship 16 January to 1 February.
covers: The full tuition fee for one international master's programme.
eligibility: Citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland.
Your Uppsala master's must be your first choice among the four you rank on University Admissions, and you must meet its entry requirements.
You must show academic talent and interest in an educational environment.
Some master's programmes, including several in biology, humanities and game design, are not eligible; Uppsala lists them.
how_to_apply: Apply to the master's on universityadmissions.se by 15 January 2027, with Uppsala first.
Pay the application fee and send complete documents by University Admissions' deadline of 1 February 2027.
Submit the scholarship application between 16 January and 1 February 2027, following Uppsala's application guide.
watch_out: About 2% of applicants receive one, so have another way to fund your studies.
It does not pay living costs.
Check your programme is not on Uppsala's list of excluded programmes before you rely on it.
costs: The scholarship, in full, if you win it

documents: Your universityadmissions.se application, with the fee paid and documents complete.

faq.q: When can I apply for the Uppsala Global Scholarship for 2027?
faq.a: The scholarship application is open from 16 January to 1 February 2027 for students starting in autumn 2027. You must also apply for your master's by 15 January 2027 with Uppsala as your first choice.
Very. Uppsala says about 2% of those who apply receive a scholarship.
